messages:
Lila (AE): Acme is spinning up a 3-node on‑prem POC. They've got 3 asks: FIPS-140 validated installer, SAML SSO, and ability to install updates in an air-gapped environment (USB/physical + delta patches). They also want a 3-month pricing quote. Any immediate blockers? :thinking:
Vikram (SE): Quick clarifying Qs — scope of FIPS? runtime libs only or entire build/signing chain? Also offline delta means no outbound catalog sync at runtime, right?
Michael (Acme IT): Correct, no outbound internet from the cluster. We can accept a one-time seed (USB) and then signed delta bundles we can apply manually. We need upgrade cadence locked during the POC (monthly) and an acceptance test matrix.
Dave (eng-packaging): Implementation notes from packaging side: we can support a signed minibundle + chunked deltas approach. Flow: initial USB seed (full installer), then apply signed delta files. Requires local package verifier (verifies signature + sha256). We already have the validator binary but need to enable FIPS crypto provider.
Dave (eng-packaging): Example manifest we expect clients to run against when applying a delta:
```
manifest:
  version: 2024-11-12
  product: redwood-inference
  delta_id: v0.1.3->v0.1.4
  sha256: 3a7f...
  signature: MEUCIQ...
```
Lila (AE): Nice. Is there an HSM requirement for signing? Customer asked about chain-of-custody for the deltas.
Nora (secops): For chain-of-custody we can offer two options: (1) Redwood signs bundles in our KMS + provide signed artifacts (we keep KMS in our cloud), or (2) customer provides an HSM+key and we sign artifacts with their key (BYOK) — latter is doable but needs extra ops work and a legal attestation. For FIPS, we need to build the installer with a FIPS-enabled distro (RHEL or Ubuntu FIPS) and run CI on FIPS nodes. That adds ~2w to bootstrapping.
Vikram (SE): Offline catalog: we can't rely on dynamic prefix caching; delta application needs local verifier and a simple sqlite catalog to track applied versions. Ops team should confirm acceptance testing steps.
Michael (Acme IT): Acceptance test: health-check, sample inference throughput (100 qps), token-level latency <120ms p95, and replay of 10 regtests. Also need SAML metadata for IdP and user provisioning docs.
Nora (secops): SAML + SSO is straightforward — we'll need metadata XML and SP configuration. For enterprise security questionnaire: they asked where keys are stored, rotation cadence, incident response SLAs. I can draft answers but need confirmation on BYOK vs Redwood KMS.
Lila (AE): Pricing ask — can we give an estimated cost line for a 3-node dedicated on‑prem POC for 3 months (incl. packaging/onboarding + engineering time for BYOK if needed)? Need ballpark for commercial team.
Vikram (SE): Ballpark: engineering/support onboarding ~80hrs (if BYOK + FIPS build, +2w). Dedicated runtime licensing: $12k/node/month reserved for POC capacity (~36k/month for 3 nodes). Onboarding + runbook + 1 enhanced support sprint ~ $25k one-time. If they accept Redwood KMS (no BYOK), reduce eng time and one-time to ~$12k. <-- rough estimate, will refine with finance.
Lila (AE): good — include that in initial quote. Also call out the 2w extra if they want full FIPS build pipeline.
Dave (eng-packaging): Ops note — delta signing workflow needs documented steps for them to apply deltas offline: verify signature, verify catalog, apply, run migrations. We'll provide a sample runbook and a portable validator binary.
Michael (Acme IT): One more: will updates require downtime? We prefer rolling updates with zero downtime if possible.
Vikram (SE): Deltas are applied rolling by default; some migrations might need a short drain window (~30-90s per node). We'll surface migratable components in the release notes.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: seeding-minibundle v0.1.3 -> v0.1.4 for POC (manual apply). CI: ok.
Lila (AE): Next steps: Vikram + Dave to send a short technical runbook + manifest example; Nora to draft security questionnaire answers with BYOK vs Redwood KMS options; I'll send pricing with the two scenarios. Michael — expected timeline from your side?
Michael (Acme IT): We can start validation in 2 weeks after contract. Need final quote this week to get internal approval. Thanks everyone. :pray:
